messages:
Charlie: FYI customer reported a 403 when calling /v1/embeddings right after they upgraded their org to a new billing tier. They say same API key works for /v1/chat but fails for embeddings. Error body: "invalid_api_key". Can someone look? :eyes:
Maya: do we have customer id or request id? usually 403 between endpoints is either scope mismatch or entitlement gating (plan flag).
Charlie: Customer id 76021, request-id 6a4f2c8e. Pasted curl below: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-001","input":"hello"}'
```
And response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {"type":"invalid_api_key", "message":"API key not authorized for embeddings"}
}
```
Charlie: They can still call /v1/chat fine with same key. They did a billing portal upgrade from "starter" to "scale" 10m ago.
Jordan: tagging billing because this smells like an entitlement flag wasn't toggled on upgrade. @Jordan can you check entitlement sync logs for org 76021?
Jordan: looked at entitlement service: their account row shows plan: scale but flags: {"embeddings_enabled": false, "priority_support": true} — hm. Sync job apparently didn't set embeddings_enabled. I see a migration job warning around 2026-11-02T14:03:11Z for a chunk of accounts.
Elaine: eng chiming in — the API returns 403 with "invalid_api_key" when either the key is invalid OR the key lacks the required feature scope/entitlement. We should avoid the misleading error string. But for immediate fix: we can flip embeddings_enabled for org 76021 or re-run the entitlement sync for that shard.
Sam: quick repro locally: create a test org with plan=scale but flags false -> calling /v1/embeddings returns same 403. So confirmed service behavior.
Maya: what's the safest remediation? Is there a hotfix we can run (DB update) or do we need a full resync? Any rollback risk?
Jordan: we have two options: 1) Run targeted DB update to set embeddings_enabled = true for org 76021; 2) Re-run the entitlement resync job for the affected batch (safer but slower). The migration warning affected ~120 orgs. I'd prefer to resync the batch and also fix 76021 now since customer is blocked.
Elaine: infra runbook: to toggle a single org we call internal admin API: 
```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/orgs/76021/flags
Body: {"embeddings_enabled": true}
```
That will update cache and push a refresh event to the authz cache. Should be safe. Do we have approvals?
Maya: customer asked for ETA. If infra can flip the flag we can tell them ~10m. Jordan, can you also schedule batch resync to avoid future hits?
Jordan: scheduling resync now for shard-3 (where the migration warning happened). ETA ~2h to finish and verify. I'll also add a one-off DB update for 76021.
InfraBot: deploy pipeline note: admin-api request requires admin token and audit log. Running oncall script will produce an audit entry.
Charlie: please paste the audit entry link when done so I can share with customer. I'll propose the workaround: use chat endpoint or alternate embedding model via dedicated endpoint while we fix.
InfraBot: completed admin call: audit id audit_8c7f. Flags updated: embeddings_enabled=true for org 76021. Cache refresh queued.
Sam: re-tested with the customer's key immediately after flag flip — embeddings call now returns 200 and a valid embedding. Verified vector length 1536.
Charlie: passing update to customer now. They confirmed success and said they were hit in a live job so grateful. :thumbsup:
Maya: follow-ups: Jordan to finish batch resync, Eng to track a small API change ticket to return clearer 403 code (403_entitlement_missing or 403_plan_limit) and update docs. Also put a metric on how often plan gating is returned as invalid_api_key.
Jordan: created ticket ENG-PLANSYNC-412, scheduled resync, and added rollback step in case of drift.
Elaine: opened API change PR draft to normalize error types and return 'entitlement_missing' with details (no PII). I'll link PR in thread.
Charlie: closing once Jordan confirms resync done. Thanks team.
Jordan: resync completed for shard-3 at 1842500032, fixed flags for ~124 orgs including 76021. Monitoring for 1h.
Charlie: verified closure with customer and updated support ticket. Marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
